name: magentic
description: Turns LLM prompts into typed Python functions with decorators for structured output, function calling, and streaming across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama, for Python developers.

skills.name: Structured Outputs
skills.description: Returns Pydantic models and other typed values from prompt-decorated functions based on the return annotation.

skills.name: Function Calling
skills.description: Lets the LLM choose Python functions to call and resolves chains of calls automatically with @prompt_chain.

skills.name: Streaming
skills.description: Streams text and structured objects as they are generated, including concurrent streams and async variants.

skills.name: Chat Prompting
skills.description: Builds prompts from system, user, and assistant message templates for few-shot and multi-turn calls.
